title: Holder Late Interest Rate and the Contract APR
content:
## Holder late interest rate — Kessler GAP Waiver Addenda

Holder late interest on a refund released to the holder runs at a yearly rate taken from the contract APR printed on the installment contract of the waiver's purchase deal, as the Vehicle Purchase Agreements records show it. A contract APR read for a holder release is a yearly rate, the printed APR divided by 100.

**Rate bands**

- Contract APR above 0.09 (9 percent): the holder late interest runs at 0.09.
- Contract APR above 0.05 (5 percent) and no more than 0.09: it runs at that contract APR.
- Contract APR of 0.05 or less, 0.00 included, or no contract APR on the deal: it runs at 0.05.

**Edge readings**

| Printed APR | Yearly rate used |
|---|---|
| 11.40 | 0.09 |
| 9.00 | 0.09 |
| 6.15 | 0.0615 |
| 5.00 | 0.05 |
| 0.00 or none printed | 0.05 |

**Hypothetical example.** A holder refund of 540.00 is released 12 days past the refund payment period on a deal printed at 6.15 APR. Holder late interest is 540.00 times 0.0615 times 12, divided by 365, which is 1.0918…, rounded half up to 1.09.
